rubric.decided: 2026-10-02, by the person, after round 2 split on exactly this
rubric.meaning: relevant means the WORK shows the subject
rubric.2: the work clearly shows the subject: papers, skills or role make it evident
rubric.1: partly: adjacent work, one strand of a career, or the subject stated (a topic chip, a keyword) with no work showing it
rubric.0: nothing on the card shows it, or the card is empty

calibration_round3.excluded: any card whose person id or name appeared in rounds 1 or 2
